messages:
oliver: prepping sealed offline package for v2.1.0-private, ready for preflight. pushing signed installer + image bundle to staging-transport. change window proposal: 2025-11-10 18:00-20:00 UTC. need pin + rollback plan :eyes:
packaging-bot: uploaded artifacts: installer-v2.1.0.tar.gz (sha256: d4f7c3a9...), images/manifest-v2.1.0.json (signed). cosign sig attached.
maya: quick heads up — QA smoke start at 17:00 UTC, can we shift earlier by 30m? otherwise we'll overlap.
samir: prefer keep 18:00 cutover to avoid biz traffic. if QA needs earlier, we can do canary at 17:30 to a 2-node private cluster.
liz: required checks: pin images to digest in manifest, embed KMS key id in transport metadata, validate cosign sigs. I'll verify checksums once packaging-bot posts final files.
packaging-bot: NOTE: artifact metadata:
```
installer: installer-v2.1.0.tar.gz
sha256: d4f7c3a9b6f1e2a8c9d0f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6
manifest: images/manifest-v2.1.0.json
manifest-digest: sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99dd00ee11ff2233445566778899aa
cosign: cosign.sig (key: projects/redwood/kms/serving-key)
```
oliver: pinging @sasha-qa for QA signoff on preflight tests and rollback triggers.
sasha-qa: will run smoke suites against the sealed bundle on staging. major rollback triggers: telemetry error rate > 5% or failed init on >3 nodes within 10 minutes. I'll post results by 17:40.
maya: found a checksum mismatch on one image layer when pulling to our airgap mirror (`sha mismatch layer 3`). packaging-bot, can you re-run packaging and reupload layer?
packaging-bot: re-run started. re-hashing layer 3... new digest: sha256:77aa88bb99cc... Replaced blob and updated manifest. New manifest-digest: sha256:cc22dd33ee44ff55... cosign re-signed.
liz: re-verify cosign:
```
cosign verify --key projects/redwood/kms/serving-key cosign.sig images/manifest-v2.1.0.json
```
packaging-bot: cosign verification: OK. manifest digest now matches uploaded artifact.
samir: good. Rollback plan: if we need to abort during cutover, deploy-bot will pin traffic back to v2.0.9 binary digest and re-open routing. ops playbook id: RB-2025-11. We should also pre-stage v2.0.9 images on mirrors as fallback.
oliver: confirm we'll pin to digests in release notes. release notes snippet:
```
Release: v2.1.0-private
Pinned images: images/serving@sha256:cc22dd33ee44ff55...
Installer: installer-v2.1.0.tar.gz (sha256: d4f7c3a9...)
Change window: 2025-11-10 18:00-20:00 UTC
Rollback: RB-2025-11 -> revert traffic to v2.0.9@sha256:998877...
```
maya: QA smoke OK on staging at 17:36, only minor lint warnings. I'm good with cutover if nothing else pops up. :thumbsup: 
samir: scheduling deploy-bot job now for canary at 17:30 (2 nodes) and full at 18:00. If canary passes for 15m, proceed.
deploy-bot: job scheduled: `deploy private:v2.1.0 --canary 2 --start 2025-11-10T17:30:00Z --full 2025-11-10T18:00:00Z`
oliver: final ask — packaging-bot, please attach transport manifest to release notes and include KMS key ID and cosign fingerprint. Also ensure mirror ttl set to 30 days.
packaging-bot: attached transport_manifest.json and metadata to release artifact. mirror_ttl: 30d. cosign_fingerprint: SHA256:ab:cd:ef:12:34:56:78:90
liz: signed off on pinning and cosign. I'll be on-call during the window.
sasha-qa: QA standing by for canary verification.
oliver: thanks all — we'll monitor telemetry and be ready to execute RB-2025-11 if needed. :rocket:
